one_sentence_story: At age 26 in 1874, Carl Wernicke discovered receptive aphasia — where left posterior temporal damage spares speech fluency while scrambling speech-sound decoding and self-monitoring — and drew the first network diagram connecting comprehension and production hubs.
so_what_for_you: Remember the less-famous stroke red flag: stroke doesn't always slur or silence speech (Broca) — sudden fluent, confident sentences that make zero sense (Wernicke) are an urgent medical emergency.
